messages:
Devon M.: Following up on the 3/14 PM: we need to finalize action owners + delivery dates for the scaling incident remediation. I'll split into tickets. Short list: backpressure runbook, autoscaler config, nightly memory scan, recurring pattern review.

Priya S.: I can own the backpressure runbook. Target: end of this week. Please assign ticket and I'll add checklist.

Nate K.: I'll take autoscaler config + verification. Need a short staging window. Tentative canary 3/19. Creating ticket now.

Lina B.: Nightly memory scan sounds good. I can add a scheduled job + alerting rule. Will coordinate with Nate on thresholds.

ops-bot: REM-5901 created by devon.m (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/REM-5901)
ops-bot: REM-5902 created by nate.k (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/REM-5902)
ops-bot: REM-5903 created by lina.b (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/REM-5903)

Devon M.: Draft RACI:
- Backpressure runbook: R=Priya S., A=Devon M., C=Oncall, I=Support
- Autoscaler config: R=Nate K., A=Devon M., C=Perf Team, I=Platform
- Nightly scan: R=Lina B., A=Priya S., C=Telemetry, I=Eng SRE
If anyone needs a different A (approver) shout now.

Priya S.: Added checklist to REM-5901: 
- draft runbook
- review w/ oncall (1 day)
- PR & merge
- dry-run in staging
I'll link PR in ticket.

Nate K.: Canary scheduled 2026-03-19 01:00-03:00 UTC. Will push metrics to REM-5902 and tag @perf-team for signoff.

Lina B.: I created a prometheus query and alert proto, linking it to REM-5903. Quick snippet below: 
```
avg_over_time(process_resident_memory_bytes[1h]) > 0.8 * machine_memory_bytes
```
Need input on sensible threshold for mixed instance types.

Priya S.: For overlap with prior caching incident: we saw memory spike + request queueing. Propose we add REM-5904 "monthly incident-pattern review" owned by Platform to capture recurring signals across incidents.

Devon M.: Agreed. I'll open REM-5904 and link back. Closure criteria: all REM-59xx tickets Done + runbook validated in staging + autoscaler canary passed + nightly scan alert firing expectedly + monthly review scheduled. Target close date: 2026-03-30.

Nate K.: After canary I'll post perf graphs and the exact config diff. If we need rollback plan, I'll include it in REM-5902.

Lina B.: I'll coordinate with telemetry to expose instance-type labels so alert is more precise.

Priya S.: Marking REM-5901 In Progress, will request oncall review after PR.

Devon M.: Thanks. I'll update the PM doc with owners & ticket links and ping this thread in 48 hours for status. @oncall please try the dry-run steps when scheduled.

ops-bot: REM-5904 created by devon.m (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/REM-5904)

Priya S.: noted, will update tickets as work progresses.

Nate K.: will post canary results 3/20 UTC.

Lina B.: will finalize alert thresholds after telemetry changes.
